statement: Let W be a simply connected closed smooth manifold of dimension D ≥ 9. There is an ordinary Morse function on W with ri(W) + ti(W) + ti−1(W) critical points of index i for every i. In particular, (2.5) SM(W) = Morse(W) = λ(W).
